themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe continue to advocate for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in public services and benefits. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, with parties like Vox, Lega, and Sverigedemokraterna leading the charge.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox continues to push for 'national priority' in public services and housing, clashing with coalition partners over budget allocations.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia advocate for policies favoring Italian nationals in social aid and public services.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sverigedemokraterna proposes stricter immigration controls and prioritization of Swedish citizens in welfare benefits.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Fremskrittspartiet emphasizes local control over immigration policies and public service allocations.
